description: This file defines an abstract base class for search page forms within Drupal, providing form building, validation, and save logic for search page entities.

classes.name: SearchPageFormBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating search page forms, handling form construction, validation, and saving for search page entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search page repository dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with the container dependency.

methods.name: getBaseFormId
methods.description: Returns the base form ID for the search entity form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, setting the plugin property from the entity.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Defines form elements for label, id, path, and plugin, and includes plugin configuration if applicable.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a search page entity with the given ID already exists.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, ensuring the path is unique and plugin configuration is valid.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, including plugin configuration submission.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity and redirects to the collection URL.
